title: From Pretraining Data to Language Models to Downstream Tasks: Tracking the Trails of Political Biases Leading to Unfair NLP Models
reasoning: The paper benchmarks and evaluates large language models on their social and economic biases using the political compass test, which includes specific propositions regarding religious values and morality (e.g., 'You cannot be moral without being religious'). Furthermore, it evaluates the fairness of downstream hate speech detection models specifically across religious identity groups, including Christians and Muslims.
